Figure 1: Overview of LenGuard-GPC for multi-view spatial reasoning. Within the staged interval [l1, l2], LenGuardGPC adaptively balances the negative KL-based consistency reward and the length bonus. When the mean per-token KL is high, the consistency reward dominates and encourages more concise reasoning. When the mean per-token KL is low, the length bonus becomes relatively stronger, preventing the model from collapsing into overly short and content-poor chains of thought.
